youtube.title: Kuch logon ko hi mosquitoes zyada kyun kaatte hain? 🦟 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Mosquitoes sach mein kuch logon ko zyada pasand karte hain. Pehle woh aapki saans ki carbon dioxide ko door se track karte hain, phir paas aakar body heat aur skin ki smell follow karte hain.

Ek study mein sabse attractive insaan ne sabse kam wale se sau guna zyada mosquitoes khinche. Aur sirf female mosquitoes kaatti hain, kyunki unhe eggs banane ke liye aapka khoon chahiye.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
